title: G5: Strict decrease at a redex, including the discarded-argument (K) case

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (S4, core).** Using G2-G4, prove that for every redex
$$[\![(\lambda x.M)N]\!]_\rho \;\succ\; [\![M[x:=N]]\!]_\rho$$
strictly in $\mathcal V_\sigma$ (equivalently $\mu(\cdot)$ strictly drops).

**Two pitfall cases that must be explicit:**
1. $x\in FV(M)$ occurring $\ge 2$ times: the argument is duplicated; strictness must survive duplication (relies on strict monotonicity G3 + increment G2).
2. **$x\notin FV(M)$ (the $K$-redex $(\lambda x.M)N\to M$):** $N$ is discarded. A measure ignoring $N$ may fail to strictly decrease unless the abstraction increment of G2 *alone* guarantees the drop. This case must be argued separately and explicitly; it is a classic source of broken SN proofs.
